claims.topicLabel: OpenAI and NVIDIA: 10 GW letter of intent (September 2025)
claims.subject: openai
claims.statement: OpenAI and NVIDIA announced on 22 September 2025, in a joint release on NVIDIA's newsroom, a letter of intent for a partnership to deploy at least 10 gigawatts of NVIDIA systems for OpenAI’s AI infrastructure, with the first gigawatt targeted for the second half of 2026 on the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform.
claims.timelineLabel: OpenAI–NVIDIA 10 GW letter of intent

time.note: Date of the NVIDIA release.

claims.qualification: A letter of intent, not a definitive agreement: the release says the companies looked forward to finalising the details "in the coming weeks". It does not show that a definitive agreement was signed, that any system was delivered or deployed, or what the systems cost. The gigawatt figure is not converted to chips or dollars here; the release’s phrase "millions of GPUs" is a description, not a count. Later status of the letter is an open question.

quantity.unit: GW (as worded: 'at least 10 gigawatts of NVIDIA systems')

supply.units: at least 10 gigawatts of NVIDIA systems

evidence.passage: OpenAI and NVIDIA today announced a letter of intent for a landmark strategic partnership to deploy at least 10 gigawatts of NVIDIA systems
The first gigawatt of NVIDIA systems will be deployed in the second half of 2026 on the NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform.
look forward to finalizing the details of this new phase of strategic partnership in the coming weeks

claims.topicLabel: OpenAI and NVIDIA: 10 GW letter of intent (September 2025)
claims.subject: nvidia
claims.statement: The joint OpenAI–NVIDIA release of 22 September 2025 stated that NVIDIA intended to invest up to $100 billion in OpenAI progressively as each gigawatt of NVIDIA systems is deployed.
claims.timelineLabel: NVIDIA states intent to invest up to $100bn in OpenAI

time.note: Date of the NVIDIA release.

claims.qualification: A stated intention under a letter of intent, conditional on deployment ("progressively as each gigawatt is deployed"). It records no invested amount, no closing and no payment, and does not show the size of any single tranche. Reports of 2026 that the arrangement changed rest on press reporting and are not recorded here (see openQuestions).
